tei:div.tei:p: 479) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i me mchod dngos grub chu gter bzhugs: 480)na mo dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ye:

skye med chos sku kun bzang mo: 'gags med rang byung rnal 'byor ma: thugs rje'i rang gzugs rgyal ba'i yum: rang byung rdo rje phag mor 'dud: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams tshogs chen gsog pa'i thabs: 'bar ba me dkyil sgrub thabs bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de nas sta gon rim pa la: sa dkyil khod snyoms gru bzhi pa: dbus 'bur mu khyud rim pas bskor: lte bar bam̐ ram̐ de'i phyi la: pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i nang: shar du ha dkar lhor ri ser: nub tu ni dmar byang sa ljang: de'i phyi rdo rje pad+ma bkod: mtha' mar me ri pa tras bskod: de steng las mthun thab dkyil ni: zla gam chos 'byung zur gsum brtsegs: me dar me 481) sgron rlung g.yab rnams: shar dang shar lho nub byang du: rim bzhin ma nor 'dzugs pa dang: gzhan yang rdzas kun ji bzhin bkod: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs: oṃ swa bhā wa sogasaḥ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ snang srid dpal yon chos so cog: 'dod yon lnga yi rgyan du shar: phyi nang gsang mchod bla na med: ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor spel: zag med bde chen bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da rū pa sogs: spar+she ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ṣa bha ling ta sarba ta na 482)ga ṇa oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: de nas mai sbar ba ni: lag gnyis mnyam pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas me sgron rdo rje'i rgyas bzung la rdzas rnams la reg bzhin: oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐: brjod bzhin me sbar: de nas rlung g.yab g.yab la: yaṃ yaṃ: brjod: me dar lag tu thogs la dbyangs snyan pos: hūm̐: ye shes rtsal las me byung bas: rang byung dbang gi thab dkyil dbus: me lha ag+ne rā dza ni: dmar gsal bgrang phreng spyi blugs 'dzin: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: pad+ma nyi ma ra skyes gdan:

gzi brjid rab 'bar mi g.yo bzhugs: de yi lto ba yangs pa'i klong: bh+rūm̐ las rang byung gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa: lhun grub bkod pa rab mdzes dbus: pad+ma nyi ma bam gdan la: bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las: rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig spyan gsum= sogs nas gzhung bzhin mchod pa yan rdzogs mthar: byon skyems 'bul ba ni: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: nyer gcig gis 'bul: rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: snod bcud snang srid bdud rtsir bsgyuraḥ mchod pa'i rdzas 483)mchog bla na med: zag med bde stong bskyed pa'i rdzas: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: sgrib gnyis ma lus kun dag nas: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ a mṛ ta swā hā: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor yon tan thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: nyer gcig phul mthar yam shing rtsa sngags dang: oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā: sham bcas lan nyer gcig phul: de nas rdzas 'dus 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' klong du: ma mā kī yis rab bskyod pa'i: 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i rdzas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir du: gos dkar mkha' dbyings klong du 'bul: tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: ma hā sarba dz+nyā na pañca pū dza la khā hi: sham bcas brgya stong khri 'bum ci 'grub 'bul: 'dod gsol ni: hoḥ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag gi rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor yon tan thams cad rgyas pa dang: khams gsum mos pa bzhi dbang du 484)'du ba dang: sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad brlag pa dang:

cho ga dang lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi dam tshig nyams chag ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas gos zung 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ srab 'jam yid 'ong pañca li: rin thang bral ba lha yi gos: bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir 'bul: bzhes nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā: de nas so rtsi 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i rdzas: bde stong myang grol bla na med: zag med 'dod yon 'di 'bul bzhes: dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā: ces grangs ldan phul nas mthar: bstod pa byas nas gtang rag ni: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid las sprul pa yi: āḥ zag med phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: hūm̐: blang dor med pa'i dam tshig rdzas: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas grub gnyis dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: ma hā ru pa sogs/ dharma pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: 485)ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling ta sarba ta na ga ṇa pū dza la khā hi: de nas gshegs skyems ni: hūm̐: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med rdzas: rang byung byang chub sems kyi sprin: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: nyer gcig re phul: yam shing rdzas 'dus bcas phul mthar: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: skye med yum chen kun bzang mo: 'gag med rang byung rnal 'byor ma: rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo la: rab gus dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: byin rlabs kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog: rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo dgongs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: mi gnas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dngos grub: deng 'dir bdag la bstsal du gsol:

rtsa sngags: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: rdzas dang phye mar dngos grub rol: de nas lhag chad bskang ba ni: hūm̐: chad pa dang ni lhag pa dang: cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang: 486)lha sngags ting 'dzin g.yel ba sogs: bag med 'gal 'khrul bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: thab tu yungs dkar 'thor bzhin yig brgya lan gsum brjod: de nas gshegs gsol ni: hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig pa nyid dmigs med ngang: badz+ra muṃ: ye shes sa rang gnas su gshegs nas dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam: de nas bsngo smon bkra shis ni: hoḥ mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du: sreg blugs mchod pa 'phul ba yi: dge rtsa ji snyed mchis pa kun: 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: bdag cag sgrub pa'i mched lcam rnams: mi gnas gtan srid zin par shog: legs tshogs yon tan phun sum tshogs: bdag cag rnams la bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs kyis: mtha' brgyan me tog 'thor bar bya: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar sbos: sa ma ya: e ma:myur zab 'bar ba'i cho ga 'di: mtsho rgyal khyod kyi thugs dam mdzod: da dus ma spel gter du sbosaḥ ma 'ongs dus ngan snyigs ma'i tshe: khyod sprul gter bdag dang 'phrad nas: chos 'di'i bstan pa mtha' rgyas nges: zab bo lag tu longs dang gsal: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyisaḥ thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: 487) skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can la gu h+ya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: ཿ ces pa 'di yang zab gter rgya mtsho'i gter grogs mdzad pa o rgyan dngos snang pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis rin chen sna tshogs dang pañca dbang mdog gi skyes bcas dus ring mo nas bka' phebs spyi bor son pa dang*/ nye char rang slob dad brtson ldan pa shī la rat+nas bskul ngor dus mtha'i gter ming 'dzin pa kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda las zhal bshus pa'o//

dge legs 'phel// zla gam chos 'byung zur gsum brtsigs: zhes pa ni 'di ltar ( Different letter here) rtsigs shing rab tsan dan dmar po'am/ min kyang 'om bus byas pa'i sor bcu gnyis dang*/ grangs drug cu tham pas g.yon bskor du drug brtsigs bya/ yam shing sor brgyad yin no// 488)
